notes_for_editor: Elevation disagrees: the Register gives 1,026 ft (313 m) and the Tennessee Landforms table gives 1,020 ft; the record's 312.7 m matches the Register. The story reports both. The Register's 11/26/22 site visit has no findings on the page read. Staffing, access and any current fire-watch use are not documented in the sources read. The record's other_names value 'A' is proposed for removal in corrections. The LS-40 stairway point comes from a general Aermotor history, not from this tower's record, and the story says so. Record coordinates match the Register.
